name: Minerva
source: Full name Ex Machina: Minerva, it is a clone of [url=/c44712]Nirvana[/url] made by [url=/c20689]Kokonoe[/url] from the notes left to her by [url=/c32476]Nine[/url] and [url=/c26279]Relius[/url]. She is always tagging alonside [url=/c26480]Celica[/url], both protecting her and acting as an amplifier for her powers. It is equipped with an Idea Engine.
